headline: US 10-Year Yields Rise While Australian Rates Data Lags
summary: US 10-year Treasury yields climbed to 4.28% on July 31, gaining 2.0 basis points from the prior day, though weekly performance shows a 5.0 basis point decline. The RBA Cash Rate stands at 3.85% as of July 29, with the AU-US 10-year spread at negative 43.0 basis points. Data for the Australian policy rate is stale, last updated two days ago.
bullets: US 10-year Treasury yield reached 4.28%, up 2.0 basis points day-over-day
Weekly performance shows US 10-year yields down 5.0 basis points from July 24
RBA Cash Rate at 3.85% as of July 29; data is stale and last updated 2 days ago
AU-US 10-year spread stands at negative 43.0 basis points
